/about.title: About — Margin
text_lines: A practice built on saying no.
Two partners and one rule: decide what matters, write it down, stay until it works.
In 2014 Nora was hired to write a growth plan for a company that already had too many of them.
She spent three months persuading the leadership team to stop four of their six priorities. Revenue grew faster that year than ever before.
One of us leads your work from first call to review.
Fifteen years in B2B marketing, the last six leading it through a Series B and C. Starts every engagement by reading the last twenty lost-deal emails.
VP Marketing at two B2B software companies
Former COO, and before that a management consultant who got tired of leaving after the final presentation. Believes most org charts are drawn a year too late.
A team led by a partner you meet twice
A fixed fee, scoped to a decision
Better to say so on the first call than three weeks in.
A strategy deck for the board and no changes
A fifth client while we have four
Not sure it’s a fit? Thirty minutes with a partner will tell you.
Strategy & growth advisory. London / Lisbon / Remote.
